name: codex-plugin-fabric
description: Local Codex MCP plugin for safe Microsoft Fabric control, deployment diagnostics, guardrails, and audit logging.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/**/*.test.js scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify:marketplace: npm test && npm run smoke && npm audit --omit=dev && node scripts/verify-marketplace.mjs
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:marketplace && npm run verify:endpoints && npm run smoke:fabric-live
